question: Which of the following folk dances is primarily associated with Rajasthan?
solution:
The correct answer is __Gair.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Gair dance is a famous folk dance associated with Rajasthan.**

 
 
• It is mainly performed by the **Bhil community.**
 
• It is performed by both men and women.
 
• Gair dance is popular in the **Mewar and Marwar regions of Rajasthan**.
 
• Performed during the festive month of Holi and Janmashtami.
 
 
 
• Some other important folk dances in Rajasthan are:
 
 
• Ghoomar.
 
• Chari.
 
• Ginad.
 
• Jhulan Leela.
 
• Kalbeliya.
 
• Bhavai.
 
• Kachchhi Ghodi.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dhimsa **is a tribal dance form of **Andhra Pradesh,** performed by women during the harvest season.
 
• Bihu is a folk dance of Assam that is performed during the Bihu festival to celebrate the onset of spring.
